# mindsmith

> An external reasoning layer for your LOCAL LLM, as an appliance: an OpenAI-compatible proxy,
> an MCP tool surface (30 tools), and local `.sgc` rooms of verified knowledge. Local-first —
> your prompts, rooms and instances stay local; the only egress is the escalation endpoint
> you explicitly configure. AGPL-3.0-or-later, Node 18+,
> no build step. The engine is the `skynet-graph` npm package; mindsmith is how you RUN it.

Key facts an agent should know before using this package:

- Four surfaces, one bin: `mindsmith serve` (OpenAI endpoint at 127.0.0.1:4747/v1 — point any
  SDK at it; every completion carries `x-sg-*` provenance headers: served-from, cost, coverage),
  `mindsmith mcp` (the tool surface over stdio for MCP hosts), `mindsmith rooms` (import/export
  verified `.sgc` stocks), `mindsmith doctor` (the onboarding diagnostic — run it FIRST; every
  non-ok line names its fix, including the WSL silent-CPU trap).
- Escalation is fail-closed and DECLARED: `mcp`/`serve` refuse to start without one of
  `--routing <config>` | env `FRONTIER_MODEL=<gguf>` | env `LLM_BASE=<url>` — the refusal names
  the fix. On WSL export `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu` or a gguf
  silently runs on CPU.
- Named instances = the working memory agents share: `instances_create` mints
  `mindsmith://<type>/<id>`; types are `plan` (persistent roadmap — needs-wiring checked at the
  door, `setGivens` reopens exactly what USED a changed premise, cause named), `dialectic` (the
  living debate — witness-gated), `notepad` (attributed notes). Every write carries `agent`;
  a write without one is a typed refusal. One `.sgp` zip per instance = the wire format.
- Refusals are data, not errors: unknown action, missing agent, a gate that says no, a
  needs-hole in a plan batch — each comes back typed and NAMED, for the agent to act on.
- What is NOT claimed: see the honesty page — every retired claim is listed, maturity is
  per-feature, nothing is field-adopted yet.
